KiCad onboarding for Waterloo Reality Labs

Session report, 2026-09-16. Everything below is local in ~/projects/uwrl-kicad-library; nothing was pushed, renamed or published.

Needs you, in order

  1. Rename the repo to kicad-library (guide, README and submodule paths already use the new name). 
    gh repo rename kicad-library -R uwrealitylabs/library
  2. Push the hierarchy branch and open its PR (restructure into 22 UWRL_* libraries, validator + CI, MIGRATION.md, the guide with 17 screenshots, Notion publisher). 
    cd ~/projects/uwrl-kicad-library
git push -u origin kicad-library-hierarchy
gh pr create -B main -H kicad-library-hierarchy -t "kicad-library: one library per category, submodule layout, validator, onboarding guide" -F .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
  3. Push the tutorial part branch after the hierarchy PR (it is one commit on top). 
    git push -u origin part/ap2210k-3.3
gh pr create -B kicad-library-hierarchy -H part/ap2210k-3.3 -t "add AP2210K-3.3 (Diodes LDO, SOT-23-5)" -F .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
  4. Publish the guide to Notion (Hardware: Wiki, page "KiCad Onboarding" + 6 child pages, 208 blocks; dry run clean, token verified as connection kicad-onboarding). Team-visible, so your call. 
    python3 scripts/notion_publish.py --publish
    Then archive the Altium onboarding pages by hand, or tell me and I will move them under an "Archive" page.
  5. PR #2 (CERN-OHL-P v2 licence) is still open on the repo; merge or close it.

Known debt

  • 240 validator warnings on legacy parts: 135 datasheet fields pointing at shop pages, 75 footprints without courtyards, the rest missing keywords or descriptions. Not blocking; listed by python3 scripts/validate.py.
  • Screenshots come from KiCad 10.0.6 on Linux with the default theme. Windows and macOS differ only in window chrome.
  • Two FoxPilot tabs are still open in Firefox (Manya's notes page, Notion integrations page); the extension policy cannot close tabs.

Regenerating screenshots

KiCad runs on Xvfb :99 with an isolated config and the tutorial project in the session scratchpad; xdotool drives the menus and ImageMagick captures the root window. Nothing touches the live desktop. The tutorial project, the launch command and the capture positions are in the session transcript; ask and I will script it into scripts/.
